description.zh:
配额申请的值。

> - 根据[ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~)中目标配额的`TotalUsage`（配额用量）和`ApplicableRange`（配额项可申请范围）来设置配额申请值。
> - 配额申请由各云产品的技术支持进行审批。如果您想增加通过几率，请在配额申请时填写合理的申请数值和详尽的申请理由。
description.en:
The value of the quota request.

> - Set the value of the quota request based on the `TotalUsage` (quota usage) and `ApplicableRange` (adjustable range of the quota) of the target quota in [ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~).
>
> - Quota requests are reviewed by the technical support of each Alibaba Cloud service. To increase the chance of approval, specify a reasonable value and a detailed reason for your request.

description.zh:
配额维度的Key。

> - N的取值范围取决于云产品支持的维度个数。
> - 当`ProductCode`为`ecs`、`ecs-spec`、`actiontrail`、`ess`等时，配额维度的Key和Value必须同时设置。
description.en:
The key of the quota dimension.

> - The number of dimensions that you can specify depends on the Alibaba Cloud service.
>
> - If `ProductCode` is `ecs`, `ecs-spec`, `actiontrail`, or `ess`, specify both the key and value of a dimension.

description.zh:
配额维度的Value。

> - N的取值范围取决于云产品支持的维度个数。
> - 当`ProductCode`为`ecs`、`ecs-spec`、`actiontrail`、`ess`等时，配额维度的Key和Value必须同时设置。
description.en:
The value of the quota dimension.

> - The number of dimensions that you can specify depends on the Alibaba Cloud service.
>
> - If `ProductCode` is `ecs`, `ecs-spec`, `actiontrail`, or `ess`, specify both the key and value of a dimension.

description.zh:
配额生效的UTC时间。
该参数仅适用于权益配额（WhiteListLabel）。 

> 数据为空表示立即生效。
description.en:
The UTC time when the quota takes effect.
This parameter applies only to privileges (WhiteListLabel).

> If this parameter is empty, the quota takes effect immediately.

description.zh:
配额告警通知的语言。取值：

- zh（默认值）：中文。
- en：英文。
description.en:
The language of the notification for a quota alert. Valid values:

- zh (default): Chinese.

- en: English.

description.zh:
配额失效的UTC时间。
该参数仅适用于权益配额（WhiteListLabel）。 

> 数据为空表示未设定UTC失效时间。
description.en:
The UTC time when the quota expires.
This parameter applies only to privileges (WhiteListLabel).

> If this parameter is empty, no expiration time is specified.

description.zh:
配额申请结果是否发送通知。取值：
- 0（默认值）：否。
- 3：是。
description.en:
Specifies whether to send a notification for the result of the quota request. Valid values:

- 0 (default): No.

- 3: Yes.

description.zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

> 关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见[ListProducts](~~440555~~)中的`ProductCode`。
description.en:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

> For more information about how to obtain the abbreviation of an Alibaba Cloud service name, see the `ProductCode` parameter in [ListProducts](~~440555~~).

description.zh:
配额ID。

> 关于如何获取云产品的配额ID，请参见[ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~)中的`QuotaActionCode`。
description.en:
The quota ID.

> For more information about how to obtain the quota ID of an Alibaba Cloud service, see the `QuotaActionCode` parameter in [ListProductQuotas](~~440554~~).

description.zh:
配额种类。取值：
- CommonQuota：通用配额。
- WhiteListLabel：权益配额。
- FlowControl：API速率配额。
description.en:
The type of the quota. Valid values:

- CommonQuota: general quota.

- WhiteListLabel: privilege.

- FlowControl: API rate limit.

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
请确保配额模板的状态为已开启（即`ServiceStatus`为`1`）。

调用[GetQuotaTemplateServiceStatus](~~450407~~)接口查询配额模板的状态，当配额模板的状态`ServiceStatus`为`0`（未设置）或`-1`（禁用）时，需要调用[ModifyQuotaTemplateServiceStatus](~~450406~~)接口将配额模板的状态修改为`1`（开启）。

### 使用说明
创建配额模板后，您可以调用[ListQuotaApplicationsForTemplate](~~2584864~~)接口查看审批结果，当`Status`显示为`Agree`时，表示审批通过。
descriptions.en:
### Prerequisites

Make sure the quota template service is enabled. The `ServiceStatus` parameter must be `1`.

You can call the [GetQuotaTemplateServiceStatus](~~450407~~) operation to query the status of the quota template service. If the `ServiceStatus` is `0` (not set) or `-1` (disabled), you can call the [ModifyQuotaTemplateServiceStatus](~~450406~~) operation to change the status to `1` (enabled).

### Usage notes

After you create a quota template, you can call the [ListQuotaApplicationsForTemplate](~~2584864~~) operation to view the approval result. If the `Status` parameter is `Agree`, the request is approved.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun quotas create-template-quota-item --product-code ecs --quota-action-code q_security-groups --desire-value 804.0 --notice-type 0 --dimensions Value=cn-hangzhou Key=regionId --env-language zh --effective-time 2021-01-19T09:25:56Z --expire-time 2021-01-20T09:25:56Z --quota-category CommonQuota --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun quotas CreateTemplateQuotaItem --region cn-hangzhou --QuotaActionCode 'q_security-groups' --Dimensions.1.Value 'cn-hangzhou' --Dimensions.1.Key regionId --ProductCode ecs --EffectiveTime '2021-01-19T09:25:56Z' --QuotaCategory CommonQuota --NoticeType 0 --DesireValue '804.0' --ExpireTime '2021-01-20T09:25:56Z' --EnvLanguage zh
